blocks.text: Pine Court, 100 Example Avenue, Example City, CA 90000. Unit 204: 2 bedrooms, 1 bathroom, 850 square feet. Base rent $2,400 per month for a 12-month lease. Available October 1, 2026. Required refundable security deposit: $1,000 once. No other fees. Water included in rent. Tenant pays electricity directly to provider; amount varies. One month free on a 12-month lease if you apply by September 15, 2026 and move in by October 1, 2026. Advertised net effective rent $2,200/month; base rent remains $2,400/month.
